test_results.output:
'''uvl
features
    UniversityCourseRegistrationSystem
        mandatory
            StudentEnrollment
                minCredits {12}
        mandatory
            UndergraduateStudent
                or
                    CoreCourse {100-level}
        mandatory
            GraduateStudent
                or
                    Seminar {500-level}
        mandatory
            CourseSelection
                optional
                    IntroToAI
                        prerequisite
                            AdvancedAI
                optional
                    LinearAlgebra
                        prerequisite
                            AdvancedAI
                exclusive
                    StatisticsForBiology
                    StatisticsForBusiness
        optional
            RoboticsLab
                maxStudents {20}
        optional
            ThesisDefense
                if
                    CreditsCompleted {60}
                    DissertationProposalPassed

'''
test_results.text: A university course registration system manages student enrollments. All students must register for a minimum of 12 credits. Undergraduate students must select one 100-level Core course, while Graduate students must select a 500-level Seminar. Many courses have prerequisites; for example, 'Advanced AI' requires both 'Intro to AI' and 'Linear Algebra'. Some courses are mutually exclusive, like 'Statistics for Biology' and 'Statistics for Business'. The 'Robotics Lab' course is an optional elective with a hard enrollment cap of 20 students. Finally, the 'Thesis Defense' module is only available to students who have completed 60 credits and passed their 'Dissertation Proposal' review.

test_results.output:
'''uvl
features
    PCConfiguratorTool
        mandatory
            CPU
                alternative
                    IntelCPU
                        mandatory
                            MotherboardSocket
                                alternative
                                    LGA1700
                                    AM5
                    AMDCPU
                        mandatory
                            MotherboardSocket
                                alternative
                                    LGA1700
                                    AM5
        mandatory
            Motherboard
                mandatory
                    Chipset
                        alternative
                            Z790
        mandatory
            RAM
                alternative
                    DDR4RAM
                    DDR5RAM
        mandatory
            GPU
                alternative
                    RTX4090
                        mandatory
                            PSU
                                minimum
                                    850W
        mandatory
            GPU
                mandatory
                    MaxGPUClearance
                        alternative
                            350mm
        mandatory
            Case
                alternative
                    ATXCase
                    MicroATXCase
                        mandatory
                            CPUCoolerClearance
                                optional
                                    LargeAirCooler
                                        mandatory
                                            MaxHeight
                                                lessThan
                                                    CPUCoolerClearance

constraints
    "CPU and MotherboardSocket are related" {IntelCPU => LGA1700; AMDCPU => AM5}
    "MotherboardChipset and RAM are related" {Z790 => DDR4RAM; Z790 => DDR5RAM}
    "RTX4090 and PSU are related" {RTX4090 => 850W}
    "GPU and MaxGPUClearance are related" {RTX4090 => 350mm}
    "Case and MotherboardFormFactor are related" {ATXCase => ATX; MicroATXCase => MicroATX}
    "LargeAirCooler and CPUCoolerClearance are related" {LargeAirCooler => CPUCoolerClearance}

'''
test_results.text: A PC configurator tool guides users. The choice of CPU (e.g., Intel vs. AMD) dictates the required motherboard socket (e.g., LGA 1700 vs. AM5). The motherboard chipset (e.g., Z790) then determines the supported RAM type (DDR4 or DDR5). A high-end GPU (e.g., RTX 4090) has a minimum power requirement, constraining the choice of Power Supply (PSU) to 850W or higher. The GPU's physical length (e.g., 350mm) must also be compatible with the case's maximum GPU clearance. Finally, the case (e.g., ATX, Micro-ATX) must match the motherboard's form factor, and an optional large air cooler's height must be less than the case's CPU cooler clearance.

test_results.output:
'''uvl
features
    CI_CD_System
        mandatory
            Build_Stage
            Unit_Test_Stage
        optional
            Staging_Deployment
                mandatory
                    Unit_Test_Pass
            Production_Deployment
                mandatory
                    Staging_Deployment_Success
                    Integration_Test_Pass
                    Security_Scan_Pass
                optional
                    Blue_Green_Strategy
                        mandatory
                            Double_Infrastructure_Resources
                    Canary_Strategy
                        mandatory
                            Monitoring_Stage
                            Rollback_Trigger
        optional
            Hotfix_Pipeline
                mandatory
                    Manual_QA_Approval_Step
                    Security_Scan_Pass

'''
test_results.text: A CI/CD system defines deployment pipelines. All pipelines must run 'Build' and 'Unit Test' stages. A 'Staging' deployment is mandatory and can only run after 'Unit Test' passes. The 'Production' deployment requires the 'Staging' deployment to succeed, and also requires both 'Integration Test' and 'Security Scan' to pass. For 'Production', the user can select either a 'Blue/Green' or 'Canary' strategy. Choosing 'Canary' automatically adds a 'Monitoring' stage with a 'Rollback' trigger. Choosing 'Blue/Green' requires double the infrastructure resources during the swap. A separate 'Hotfix' pipeline can bypass 'Staging' and 'Integration Test', but requires a 'Manual QA Approval' step and must still pass the 'Security Scan'.

test_results.output:
'''uvl
features
    SmartHomeAutomationSystem

constraints
    Priority
        MovieModePriority > MorningPriority

    SafetyConstraints
        SmartOvenAction => HomeStatus = Away

    WindowSensorConstraint
        AirConditionerAction
            WindowSensorState = Open
        AirConditionerAction
            WindowSensorState = Closed
                delay 5min

'''
test_results.text: A smart home automation system links devices based on rules. A rule has triggers, optional conditions, and actions. Rules must have priorities to resolve conflicts: the 'Movie Mode' scene (sets lights to 10%) must block the 'Morning' scene (sets lights to 100%) from running. Safety constraints are critical: the 'Smart Oven' action is disabled if 'Home Status' is 'Away'. Also, the 'Air Conditioner' action is dynamically disabled if any 'Window Sensor' reports 'Open' and only re-enables 5 minutes after all windows are closed.
